title: Tiefenbachklamm Kramsach
highlights: Picturesque hike along the emerald-green Brandenberger Ache river
Daring observation platform towering high above the riverbed
Impressive rock formations and tranquil gravel banks
Refreshing shady retreat during hot summer days
kurzbeschreibung: The Tiefenbachklamm between Kramsach and Brandenberg fascinates with bizarre rock formations and a spectacular suspension bridge.
beschreibung:
Hiking Along the Roaring Wild River

The Tiefenbachklamm connects Kramsach with Brandenberg and offers a varied gorge walk along the rushing Brandenberger Ache. Over the centuries, the water has carved bizarre shapes into the rock walls and created crystal-clear natural pools.

Spectacular Viewing Platform

A well-maintained walking trail leads across narrow wooden footbridges, moss-covered slopes, and secured rock passages. The highlight of the route is a cantilevered viewing platform suspended high above the deepest part of the gorge, from which visitors can observe the foaming white water and daring kayakers at close quarters.
